capabilities: Maximise the active pane to fill the workspace
Toggle maximised state with a command or hotkey
disambiguation: Maximises a pane inside the Obsidian workspace, not the application window or the operating-system window.
extras: The README states the plugin is 'all very experimental'; it is free and open-source with an optional donation link. It also carries a standard security notice about third-party plugins.
problem: Obsidian's split-pane layout leaves multiple panes visible at once, and there is no built-in way to temporarily focus the active pane full-size.
summary: Workspace layout plugin that fills the Obsidian workspace with the currently active pane via a toggleable command and hotkey.
